sneakerscope.title: sneakerscope
sneakerscope.tagline: real-time analytics for the sneaker market.
sneakerscope.context: the sneaker resale market moves fast: prices shift by the hour with drops, hype and platforms. resellers and collectors navigate by instinct, without a serious tool to aggregate the data.
sneakerscope.problem: how do you turn a massive, volatile stream of sales data into simple decisions? the data had to be collected, cleaned and analysed continuously, then rendered readable — without requiring analyst skills from the user.
sneakerscope.approach: i designed the platform end to end: a FastAPI + PostgreSQL collection pipeline, Redis cache for hot data, a proprietary scoring algorithm and an AI advisor (Gemini) that answers in natural language. on the front: Next.js and Recharts for real-time reports.
sneakerscope.results: a complete platform, from raw data to personalised advice — and a continuous product playground: scoring, applied AI, data visualisation.
sneakerscope.metaDescription: SneakerScope case study: a real-time sneaker market analytics platform — Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis and AI (Gemini).

7eyes.title: 7eyes
7eyes.tagline: an immersive website shaped after an artist.
7eyes.context: 7eyes, a french rapper, needed an online presence that lived up to his world: dark, precise, immersive. not a mere business card — an extension of his artistic identity.
7eyes.problem: translating a musical identity into a web experience: something to listen to, look at and feel, without sacrificing performance or readability.
7eyes.approach: an immersive design built around listening: integrated audio player, fluid animations (Framer Motion), dark aesthetics and assertive typography. built with Next.js, mobile-first.
7eyes.results: a production website serving as the artist's official showcase — music, visual universe and news in one place.
7eyes.metaDescription: 7eyes case study: an immersive artist website for a french rapper — integrated audio player, dark aesthetics, Next.js and Framer Motion.

lumiere-de-soso.title: lumière de soso
lumiere-de-soso.tagline: a headless store built to sell differently.
lumiere-de-soso.context: lumière de soso, an artisanal brand, wanted to sell online without looking like yet another template. the challenge: a store that tells the brand's story while staying easy to run day to day.
lumiere-de-soso.problem: reconciling a custom shopping experience with the robustness of a proven platform: payments, stock, orders — without reinventing the back-office wheel.
lumiere-de-soso.approach: headless architecture: Shopify as the e-commerce engine (products, cart, payments), Next.js for a fully custom storefront. fluid cart, discreet animations, frictionless purchase journey.
lumiere-de-soso.results: a store in production: the brand manages its catalogue in Shopify, customers shop in an experience unique to the brand.
lumiere-de-soso.metaDescription: Lumière de Soso case study: a custom headless e-commerce store — Shopify API, Next.js, TypeScript and Framer Motion.

th14.title: th14
th14.tagline: a typographic tribute to thierry henry.
th14.context: a self-initiated project: paying tribute to thierry henry's career through a narrative web experience. a playground to push typographic design and animation.
th14.problem: telling a legendary career interactively: pacing the narrative, guiding the scroll, making key moments felt — with nothing but typography, motion and space.
th14.approach: scroll-driven storytelling orchestrated with GSAP and Framer Motion, assertive typographic design, polished transitions. each section maps to an era of his career.
th14.results: a portfolio piece that demonstrates mastery of web animation and interactive storytelling — and a lab for techniques later reused on client projects.
th14.metaDescription: TH14 case study: a narrative web experience honouring Thierry Henry — typographic design, GSAP and Framer Motion.

studio.title: studio
studio.tagline: this site — my studio's showcase, from folio to studio stance.
studio.context: repositioning my own site: moving from an artist's portfolio to the front door of a studio that solves client problems — without losing any of the craft or execution.
studio.problem: building a strong identity and a fluid journey (offer, method, case studies, contact) that earns a prospect's trust, while keeping a recognisable creative signature.
studio.approach: an editorial art direction (Playfair, blue accents, cream), cinematic scrolling (Lenis) and bespoke transitions: work-to-case-study morph, scroll-inked text, atmospheric hero.
studio.results: the site you're browsing: a coherent studio showcase, from hero to contact, designed to turn a visitor into a project.
studio.metaDescription: Case study: enzo gazzoli's studio site — editorial art direction, cinematic scrolling, bespoke transitions.

off-screen.title: off screen
off-screen.tagline: a contemplative, raw and minimalist visual experience.
off-screen.context: a self-initiated project: a series of looping still shots, conceived as a visual breath. an exercise in restraint — showing little, but exactly right.
off-screen.problem: creating a contemplative mood with no narrative and no chatty interface: holding attention through rhythm, grain and silence rather than content.
off-screen.approach: looping still shots, organic blur, raw aesthetics and minimal typography. the motion is slow, deliberately, to set an atmosphere.
off-screen.results: an atmospheric piece exploring radical restraint — a counterpoint to client work, and a testbed for tempo and texture.
off-screen.metaDescription: off screen case study: a contemplative, raw and minimalist visual experience — Next.js, React, Framer Motion.
